title: Zephyrus-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Weather Reporting

claim.summary: Zephyrus-R1 trains tool-using vision-language weather agents with a two-stage curriculum, RL on verifiable weather-analysis questions followed by RL on report generation scored by a meteorological rubric and bidirectional claim entailment against NWS discussions and gated on evidence read at the current state and a forecast lead.

modules.name: Verifiable-question to report curriculum RL
modules.scope_reason: CISPO-based RL with LoRA updates the vision-language policy, first on verifier-scored weather-analysis questions and then on the report reward, so the contribution changes the model itself.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "Direct report training must jointly learn"
PDF p.7; passage beginning "Both RL stages use CISPO with"

modules.name: Grounding-gated rubric and claim-entailment report reward
modules.scope_reason: The reward compares a generated forecast discussion with the NWS reference through a six-criterion meteorological rubric and claim-level Discussion F1, and its grounding flag requires reads of the current state and a forecast lead, so the verifier is bound to the weather-report output.
